sanskrit: yasya bāhupratāpena tāpitāḥ sarvato vayam tam agnim iva vastreṇa kathaṃ chāditavaty asi yasya bāhubalaṃ ghoraṃ dhārtarāṣṭrair upāsitam
english: He by the might of whose arms we were scorched on every side—how could you have kept him concealed, like a fire wrapped in a garment? He whose terrible strength of arm the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra leaned upon for support—

sanskrit: nānyaḥ kuntīsutāt karṇād agṛhṇād rathināṃ rathī sa naḥ prathamajo bhrātā sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ asūta taṃ bhavaty agre katham adbhutavikramam
english: No other chariot-warrior among warriors could withstand Karṇa, the son of Kuntī. He was our first-born brother, the foremost of all who bear weapons. How is it, lady, that you bore him first, him of wondrous valor?

sanskrit: aho bhavatyā mantrasya pidhānena vayaṃ hatāḥ nidhanena hi karṇasya pīḍitāḥ sma sabāndhavāḥ
english: Alas, by the concealing of this counsel of yours we are undone; for by the slaying of Karṇa we have been crushed, together with our kinsmen.

sanskrit: abhimanyor vināśena draupadeyavadhena ca pāñcālānāṃ ca nāśena kurūṇāṃ patanena ca
english: By the destruction of Abhimanyu, by the slaughter of the sons of Draupadī, by the ruin of the Pāñcālas, and by the fall of the Kurus—

sanskrit: tataḥ śataguṇaṃ duḥkham idaṃ mām aspṛśad bhṛśam karṇam evānuśocan hi dahyāmy agnāv ivāhitaḥ
english: this grief, a hundredfold greater than all of that, has touched me to the quick; for grieving over Karṇa I burn as though cast into a fire.

sanskrit: na hi sma kiṃ cid aprāpyaṃ bhaved api divi sthitam na ca sma vaiśasaṃ ghoraṃ kauravāntakaraṃ bhavet
english: Nothing whatever would have been beyond our reach, even were it set in heaven, nor would this terrible carnage, which has brought the Kauravas to their end, ever have come to pass.

sanskrit: evaṃ vilapya bahulaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ vinadañ śanakai rājaṃś cakārāsyodakaṃ prabhuḥ
english: Having lamented thus at great length, O king, the King of Righteousness, Yudhiṣṭhira, wailing softly, the lord performed the water-offering for him.

sanskrit: tato vineduḥ sahasā strīpuṃsās tatra sarvaśaḥ abhito ye sthitās tatra tasminn udakakarmaṇi
english: Then on all sides the women and men who stood about there, gathered for that water-rite, suddenly broke into wailing.

sanskrit: tata ānāyayām āsa karṇasya saparicchadam striyaḥ kurupatir dhīmān bhrātuḥ premṇā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Then the wise lord of the Kurus, Yudhiṣṭhira, out of love for his brother, had Karṇa's women brought forth with their retinue.

sanskrit: sa tābhiḥ saha dharmātmā pretakṛtyam anantaram kṛtvottatāra gaṅgāyāḥ salilād ākulendriyaḥ
english: Then, together with them, that righteous-souled one performed the funeral rites; and having done so, his senses overwhelmed, he came up out of the waters of the Gaṅgā.
